name: Autosomal Recessive Secondary Polycythemia Not Associated with VHL Gene
aliases: Non-VHL Related Autosomal Recessive Secondary Polycythemia
Hereditary Secondary Polycythemia Excluding VHL Mutation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Autosomal Recessive Secondary Polycythemia (Non-VHL)

criteria.description: Sustained elevated hemoglobin and hematocrit levels consistent with polycythemia
Absence of pathogenic variants in the VHL gene confirmed by genetic testing
Consistent autosomal recessive inheritance pattern or positive family history
Elevated or inappropriately normal serum erythropoietin levels
Exclusion of acquired causes of secondary polycythemia such as hypoxia, tumors, or exogenous erythropoietin use

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of sustained erythrocytosis, absence of VHL gene mutations, consistent autosomal recessive inheritance pattern, and exclusion of other secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing should include sequencing of known genes associated with secondary polycythemia excluding VHL.
